name: Makita XCU07
blurb: 36 V (2×18 V) cordless saw: 12″, 14″ or 16″ bars, 3/8″ low-profile chain, .043″ (90PX) or .050″ (91PX), 46 / 52 / 56 drive links; 14″ is standard.
intro: The XCU07's manual lists the same 12″, 14″ and 16″ bar-and-chain combinations as the XCU03 and XCU04 (standard bar 14″): chain type 90PX for .043″ gauge or 91PX for .050″ gauge, both 3/8″ pitch, 46, 52 or 56 drive links. It also lists a 10″ curved bar with a 1/4″-pitch 25AP chain (60 drive links, .050″), which uses a different sprocket; that setup isn't tabulated here. As with the other Makita 36 V saws, the gauge decides which loop fits, so check the bar.

bars.label: 12″ (90PX, .043″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 90PX, 46 drive links, bar part 165245-8, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 90PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.5 mm (11/64″; the manual prints it as 3/16″).

bars.label: 14″ (90PX, .043″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 90PX, 52 drive links, bar part 165246-6, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 90PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.5 mm (11/64″; the manual prints it as 3/16″).

bars.label: 16″ (90PX, .043″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 90PX, 56 drive links, bar part 165247-4, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 90PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.5 mm (11/64″; the manual prints it as 3/16″).

bars.label: 12″ (91PX, .050″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 91PX, 46 drive links, bar part 165200-0, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 91PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.0 mm (5/32″).

bars.label: 14″ (91PX, .050″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 91PX, 52 drive links, bar part 165201-8, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 91PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.0 mm (5/32″).

bars.label: 16″ (91PX, .050″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 91PX, 56 drive links, bar part 165202-6, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 91PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.0 mm (5/32″).
